page: Microsoft Azure E4as_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz, featuring 2 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs via multithreading. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The CPU configuration provides 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, with hardware instruction support that includes AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and AES cryptography. The instance contains no bundled local storage and includes no dedicated hardware GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded compute efficiency. In stress-ng single-core tests, the instance reached 3556.07 points, placing it in the top 10% of tested instances, paired with top-tier compression results including 38.71 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 17.73 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Aggregate multi-core throughput aligns with its 4-vCPU allocation, recording an average stress-ng multi-core score of 7164.89 and a PassMark CPU score of 9677.68. Uncached large-block memory bandwidth sustains 46.13 GB/sec for reads and 33.69 GB/sec for writes. Conversely, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (34.07 GB/sec) and PassMark database operations (2595.27) fell into the lower quartiles.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the E4as_v7 provides resource-dense RAM allocation suitable for in-memory key-value caching, medium-scale memory-resident applications, and data pre-processing jobs that require substantial memory per thread without requiring high core counts. However, because local storage is absent and multi-threaded scaling is limited by the 2 physical cores, persistent high-throughput database workloads require external remote storage volumes.
description: Microsoft Azure E4as_v7 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 4 vCPUs and 2 physical cores from an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of memory. Based on the x86_64 architecture with 32 MB L3 cache and AVX-512 support, the instance allocates 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local disk storage or GPU acceleration. In benchmark evaluations, the E4as_v7 achieves top-tier single-core performance in stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression, while multi-core compute and PassMark CPU metrics sit within the middle tier. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 46.13 GB/sec. Given its memory-dense profile and low core footprint, it is appropriate for memory-intensive caching layers such as Redis, lightweight in-memory data processing, and enterprise application services that require dedicated memory capacity per core.
